instrument_count.scope: Saved explicit reference closure across 203 projects; not simultaneous voices.

limits: Counts describe saved references, not executed DSP time.
SAMPLER appears in 65 projects; only 32 have nonzero resolved sample bytes. Training always supplies valid generated samples.
Calibration is not a measured PGO speed result.
Phrase FX density counts unique saved reachable phrases, not instruction-weighted execution. Generated controls are original; no real-project patterns are copied.

phrase_fx.scope: Unique phrases reachable from explicit saved Song and Chain references; active rows only, not instruction-weighted playback.

scope: Static explicit Song reference closure, not simultaneous voices or instruction-weighted playback. Aggregate counts only.

training_selection.engine_allocation: Largest remainder across 306 representative instrument references, with deterministic one/two/three variants per track and three dense 24-instrument arrangements.
training_selection.feature_allocation: Match project presence and instrument fractions for filters and each send.
training_selection.instrument_variants: Match mean 12.75 versus corpus 12.7438; retain original engine, filter and send proportions. Variants share generated sampler assets.
training_selection.phrase_controls: Match 0.4008 FX commands per saved active phrase row. Place original filter, pitch, retrigger, repeat and engine controls only on existing notes; keep OFF rows unchanged. Four anchors remain byte-identical.
training_selection.sample_allocation: Eight representative sampler projects provide all dependencies. Positive generated bytes span the resolved-sample quantiles; their project frequency follows sampler references, not the 32 resolved assets.
training_selection.tempo_allocation: 24 evenly spaced empirical quantiles, including 20 and 360 BPM.
training_selection.track_limit: 19/24 eight-track projects (79.2%) versus 171/203 (84.2%); retain one each of 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 tracks instead of removing light controls.
training_selection.unqualified: Compare this recipe with corpus-trained code before adoption. Metadata agreement cannot prove the target within about 2%.
